title: 経営分析とＥＳＧ
subtitle: Business Analysis and ESG
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning/education goal of the Faculty of Management Information. In order for managers to fulfill their duties in the future, analytical information on management activities is required. In this course, students will acquire the knowledge and skills necessary for management analysis and develop the ability to make comprehensive judgments on the results of management analysis from a multifaceted perspective.
advice:
In the first part of the course, students will review their knowledge of preparing financial statements
(such as bookkeeping).
In the second part, students will learn the key points of financial analysis and analytical indicators. And then, students will practice financial analysis of specific companies using the analytical indicators they have learned.
 Finally, students will prepare and give a presentation on the results of their financial analysis.
When doing the assigned exercises, it is important that students pay attention to economic news and company information and study in depth their target company and industry.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand that financial analysis information is useful for making decisions.
Be able to collect and organize corporate information through EDINET, HP, and other media.
Be able to understand the indicators of financial analysis and use them in exercises.
Be able to describe the findings from the financial analysis, considering the corporate environment.
Be able to understand how to prepare and the characteristics of various financial statements.

achievementLevels.ideal:
・ Be able to recognize that financial analysis information is useful for managers and interested parties, and understand what information users are looking for.
・ Be able to use EDINET and HP to collect company and industry information and analyze characteristics of specific industries and companies.
・ Be able to analyze the financial status of specific companies using accounting-related knowledge and financial analysis formulas.
・ Be able to summarize the results of financial analysis in reports, and create materials.
・　Be able to explain the methods for preparing and characteristics of various financial statements.
achievementLevels.standard:
・ Be able to understand that financial analysis results are useful for managers and interested parties.
・ Be able to use EDINET and HP to collect company and industry information.
・ Be able to calculate indicators of financial analysis for specific companies.
・ Be able to summarize the results of financial analysis in reports and give appropriate presentations.
・　Be able to understand how to prepare and the characteristics of various financial statements.

              This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning/education goal of the Faculty of Management Information. In order for managers to fulfill their duties in the future, analytical information on management activities is required. In this course, students will acquire the knowledge and skills necessary for management analysis and develop the ability to make comprehensive judgments on the results of management analysis from a multifaceted perspective.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In the first part of the course, students will review their knowledge of preparing financial statements
(such as bookkeeping).
In the second part, students will learn the key points of financial analysis and analytical indicators. And then, students will practice financial analysis of specific companies using the analytical indicators they have learned.
 Finally, students will prepare and give a presentation on the results of their financial analysis.
When doing the assigned exercises, it is important that students pay attention to economic news and company information and study in depth their target company and industry.
